title: Smooth nearest sampling for scaled pixel art
purpose: Keep pixel art crisp but free of shimmering when it is rotated, moved by sub-pixels or scaled by non-integer factors: texel edges are blended over exactly one screen pixel with linear filtering, interiors stay flat.

inputs: A pixel art texture on a Sprite2D whose `texture_filter` is set to Linear (as in `demo.tscn`).
contract.outputs: A 24-pixel sprite scaled seven times with crisp, flat texels and smooth edges.

limits: Requires the node's texture filter set to Linear; with Nearest filtering it has no effect. Mipmaps must be off or the blend smears when minified.
technique_references: Anti-aliased nearest-neighbour sampling (bilinear blend confined to one screen pixel at texel edges)
